themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can independently perform research tasks, make decisions, and interact with systems or data.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that help developers write, debug, and review code, accelerating the software development lifecycle.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI-powered tools designed to aid researchers in tasks like data analysis, literature review, and hypothesis generation.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare the features, performance, and pricing of various AI research tools and platforms.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores how AI can be applied to enhance design processes, from concept generation to user interface design and prototyping.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the behavior, capabilities, limitations, and user interactions with AI-powered chatbots.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI influences job roles, skills requirements, hiring, and the overall labor market.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the use of AI-generated or simulated users for testing and research purposes, comparing them to human respondents.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications that condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI sentiment & feedback analysis
themes.description: Covers the use of AI to analyze text or other data for emotional tone, opinions, and user feedback.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
